name: Beta Gallery
description: Beta channel of the Gallery plugin: disk-backed media browsing and workflow inspection under its own /beta-gallery API prefix, so it can be installed alongside the stable Gallery. Also serves as the boilerplate for future beta plugin channels.
author: LainStable

volumes.description: Media root that this beta gallery browses (media, captions and metadata are read directly from here).

assistant_actions.name: scan_status
assistant_actions.description: Report beta gallery status for the configured media root (counts, optimize state).

assistant_actions.name: rescan_library
assistant_actions.description: Rescan the beta gallery library so new or removed media shows up.

assistant_actions.name: optimize_folder
assistant_actions.description: Optimize the images in a beta gallery folder (convert oversized files to the configured format).

params.name: folder
params.description: Folder path relative to the beta gallery root.
